property_summary: After any successful fillOrder, the contract must store the position expiration as the fill time plus order.duration (i.e. positionExpirations[k] == fillTimestamp + duration); the mutant stores the raw duration, which differs from the correct value whenever duration != fillTimestamp + duration (e.g. any non-tiny duration at a normal timestamp).
change_summary: Store order.duration instead of block.timestamp + order.duration as the position expiration.
